title: Redact isSecret configuration fields in the dry-run config dump
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/src/transports/dryModeRunner.ts (DryRunModeRunner.dumpConfig, lines 43-46), stop logging JSON.stringify(this.userConfig) raw. Build a copy of UserConfig where every field marked isSecret:true in src/common/config/userConfig.ts (connectionString, apiClientId, apiClientSecret, voyageApiKey and any future isSecret field) is replaced with a fixed redaction marker, or pass the output through the mongodb-redact redact() helper already used by LoggerBase.redactIfNecessary and Telemetry.sendEvents. Derive the redaction list from the isSecret metadata, not a hard-coded list, so new secret fields are covered. Add a unit test. Constraints: same release process as task 1 (normal change, 1 approval, dev -> qa -> prod). No change freeze is recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the server with MDB_MCP_DRY_RUN=true and sentinel non-secret placeholder values (e.g. SENTINEL-DRYRUN-0001) in the connection string, apiClientSecret and voyageApiKey prints a config dump in which no sentinel value appears
A unit test iterates every isSecret:true field in userConfig.ts and asserts its value is absent from the dumpConfig output, and passes in `pnpm test`
Re-running probe-schemas produces no SCH-API-06 fail result at src/transports/dryModeRunner.ts

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit. Expect no SCH-API-06 result for src/transports/dryModeRunner.ts and fingerprint 49267cdf... absent, so the ledger can resolve fnd_01M2GMWQ01QA647X5MYFGNS1MG.

rootCause.description: dumpConfig bypasses the codebase's redaction path and serialises the full resolved UserConfig to stdout, ignoring the isSecret markers declared in userConfig.ts.
